scope: Read-only diagnosis of live breadth history and already-visible CN price dates. No new market data, cache repairs, backfills, or research experiments.

CN_ALL_A.price_axis_source: current visible CN SSE 1 year date selector
CN_ALL_A.gap_type: source date rows absent; not null or invalid fields on present dates

SP500.exact_price_axis_gap_count: not_evaluated; US page price dates not supplied; no new price fetch performed

findings.conclusion: Missing breadth dates map to null on the price-date axis. connectNulls:false breaks both the breadth line and its rails. All present recent values are in 0..100; out-of-range y clipping does not explain these gaps.

Seven live price-date rows absent. Six were present in the August 27 backup, so the gap cannot be described as seven never-collected days. Exact deletion/overwrite event and actor remain unknown. August 19 is also absent from that backup.
findings.historical_writer_boundary: Commit 407573b4 scripts/backfill_breadth_full.py:246 wrote directly to the live JSON; current line 246 writes a separate full-history research JSON. This establishes a historical overwrite-capable path, not proof of the event that removed these six rows.

findings.conclusion: Three source dates absent: September 9, 22, 23. Logs show a repeated represented date September 8 then skip, and two repeated September 21 calls then skip before the next September 24 result. This proves stale represented-date/skip behavior existed in the generator. Logs do not include independent execution timestamps, so they cannot strictly date those calls or prove a specific upstream network cause.

All ten missing October 19-30 price dates have explicit qualification failures and preserve-old-history messages. The current writer returns before snapshot/history updates unless quality.status is verified. These rows were withheld by the data qualification gate.

qualification_sidecar.interpretation: The October 30 sample receipt matches the current qfq parquet bytes. It does not bind or qualify the live breadth-history JSON or retroactively validate the October 16 legacy reading. Invalidated legacy dates are accumulated by the sidecar writer.
qualification_sidecar.reader_hash_limit: These readers do not rehash the price parquet; this audit independently checked the actual bytes.
